events.name: Knoxville Nationals
events.intro: Knoxville Raceway, Knoxville, Iowa. First run in 1961 as the Super Modified National Championship; the Knoxville Nationals name dates to 1978. Run in August on the half-mile.

finish.status: jason meyers racing w/ clauson-marshall racing.

events.name: Kings Royal
events.intro: Eldora Speedway, Rossburg, Ohio. First run in 1984; in 2021 it was run twice on the same day, an afternoon race and a night race.

events.name: National Open
events.intro: Williams Grove Speedway, Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania. First run on October 20, 1963, when Gordon Johncock won; the "Biggest Race in the East" closes the Central Pennsylvania 410 season.

events.name: Chili Bowl Midget Nationals
events.intro: Tulsa Expo Raceway, Tulsa, Oklahoma. Indoor midget race first run in January 1987. The A-main went to 55 laps in 2012 and was run at 40 laps in 2025.

events.name: Australian Classic
events.intro: Grand Annual Sprintcar Classic, Premier Speedway, Warrnambool, Victoria. First run in 1973, when Zeke Agars won; run each January.

races.not_held: Abandoned after the C-main because of rain
Not run under the Grand Annual name (replaced by the 50 for Fifty because of travel restrictions)
